components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single strongest action in a task flow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { position: relative; min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid var(--love, #d86d4a); border-radius: var(--radius-s, 4px); padding: .7rem 1.35rem; background: var(--love, #d86d4a); color: var(--on-accent, #fff); box-shadow: 0 12px 32px color-mix(in srgb, var(--love, #d86d4a) 24%, transparent); font-family: var(--font-mono, monospace); font-size: .75rem; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), box-shadow 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 16px 42px color-mix(in srgb, var(--love, #d86d4a) 30%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--love, #d86d4a) 70%, white); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translate(1px,1px); }

components.name: Toolbar Control
components.description: A compact filter or sort control with instrument-readout typography.
components.css: .ds-control-label { display: grid; gap: .35rem; color: var(--muted, #858d90); font-family: var(--font-mono, monospace); font-size: .62rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .08em; } .ds-control { min-height: 44px; border: 1px solid var(--border-color, rgba(242,241,234,.18)); border-radius: var(--radius-s, 4px); padding: .7rem 2.5rem .7rem .85rem; background: var(--surface, #101417); color: var(--text, #f2f1ea); font: 700 .7rem/1.1 var(--font-mono, monospace); } .ds-control:hover { border-color: var(--love, #d86d4a); } .ds-control:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--love, #d86d4a) 70%, white); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Selected View Chip
components.description: The active mode in a small mutually exclusive control set.
components.css: .ds-chip-selected { min-width: 44px; min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid var(--love, #d86d4a); border-radius: var(--radius-s, 4px); padding: .5rem .75rem; background: var(--love, #d86d4a); color: var(--on-accent, #fff); font: 700 .67rem/1 var(--font-mono, monospace); } .ds-chip-selected:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--love, #d86d4a) 92%, white); } .ds-chip-selected:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--love, #d86d4a) 70%, white); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-candidate { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 2.4rem minmax(0,1fr) auto; gap: 1rem; align-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--grid-hairline, #2c2e31); border-radius: var(--radius-m, 6px); padding: 1rem; background: var(--intelligence-surface, #151719); color: var(--text, #f2f1ea); font-family: var(--font-display, sans-serif); } .ds-candidate h3,.ds-candidate p,.ds-candidate dl { margin: 0; } .ds-candidate p { margin-top: .25rem; color: var(--muted, #858d90); font-size: .78rem; } .ds-rank,.ds-candidate dt,.ds-candidate dd { font-family: var(--font-mono, monospace); } .ds-rank { color: var(--intelligence-copper, #c6764d); font-size: .7rem; } .ds-candidate dl { display: flex; gap: 1rem; } .ds-candidate dt { color: var(--muted, #858d90); font-size: .58rem; letter-spacing: .08em; } .ds-candidate dd { color: var(--text, #f2f1ea); font-size: .74rem; font-weight: 800; } .ds-candidate .ds-healthy { color: var(--pine, #89c8b6); } .ds-candidate:hover { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--love, #d86d4a) 60%, var(--grid-hairline, #2c2e31)); } .ds-candidate:focus-within { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--love, #d86d4a) 70%, white); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Source Health Record
components.description: A compact receipt for freshness, coverage, and ingestion status.
components.css: .ds-source { border: 1px solid var(--grid-hairline, #2c2e31); padding: 1rem; background: var(--intelligence-surface, #151719); color: var(--text, #f2f1ea); } .ds-source header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; align-items: baseline; } .ds-source h3,.ds-source dl { margin: 0; } .ds-source h3 { font: 700 .95rem/1.2 var(--font-display, sans-serif); } .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .4rem; color: var(--subtle, #c5cbc8); font: 700 .62rem/1 var(--font-mono, monospace); letter-spacing: .08em; } .ds-status i { width: .4rem; height: .4rem; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--pine, #89c8b6); } .ds-source dl { display: grid; gap: .45rem; margin-top: .8rem; } .ds-source dl div { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 6rem 1fr; gap: .5rem; } .ds-source dt,.ds-source dd { margin: 0; font: .66rem/1.35 var(--font-mono, monospace); } .ds-source dt { color: var(--muted, #858d90); } .ds-source dd { color: var(--subtle, #c5cbc8); } .ds-source:hover { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--love, #d86d4a) 45%, var(--grid-hairline, #2c2e31)); } .ds-source:focus-within { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--love, #d86d4a) 70%, white); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Compare Lens
components.description: A quiet, border-bottom select embedded in the compare evidence rail.
components.css: .ds-lens { display: grid; gap: .3rem; padding: .7rem .8rem; border: 1px solid var(--grid-hairline, #2c2e31); background: var(--intelligence-surface, #151719); } .ds-lens span { color: var(--muted, #858d90); font: 800 .58rem/1.35 var(--font-mono, monospace); letter-spacing: .05em; } .ds-lens select { width: 100%; min-height: 36px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color, rgba(242,241,234,.18)); border-radius: 0; padding: .35rem 1.5rem .35rem 0; background: transparent; color: var(--text, #f2f1ea); font: 750 .7rem/1.35 var(--font-mono, monospace); } .ds-lens select:hover { border-bottom-color: var(--love, #d86d4a); } .ds-lens select:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--love, #d86d4a) 70%, white); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-lens p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted, #858d90); font: .62rem/1.35 var(--font-mono, monospace); }

components.name: Plot Legend
components.description: The compact legend used beside quality-price and benchmark plots.
components.css: .ds-legend { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 1rem; color: var(--muted, #858d90); font: .65rem/1.3 var(--font-mono, monospace); } .ds-legend span { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .4rem; } .ds-legend i { width: .55rem; height: .55rem; border-radius: 50%; } .ds-top { background: var(--intelligence-copper, #c6764d); } .ds-field { background: var(--intelligence-blue, #668796); } .ds-legend span:hover { color: var(--text, #f2f1ea); } .ds-legend span:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--love, #d86d4a) 70%, white); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
AI Stats should feel like a trusted measurement instrument, not a marketing dashboard. The interface is dense enough to reward investigation but disciplined enough that a first-time visitor can choose a task, understand the recommendation, and inspect the evidence without decoding the page.

Near-black fields, warm neutral type, muted copper controls, restrained blue-gray plots, and monospaced measurement labels create a recognizable technical world. Hairline dividers carry most of the structure. The system avoids oversized ornamental cards, decorative gradients, and universal-rank spectacle.
keyCharacteristics: Task-first hierarchy with evidence immediately available.
Compact measurement labels paired with plain-language interpretation.
Hairline grids and tonal layering instead of card sprawl.
Copper reserved for decisions, selections, and the most important plotted point.
Charts remain readable as data tables or source receipts.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Copper should occupy a small fraction of a screen. Its scarcity gives selections and primary actions meaning.

rules.name: The Evidence Color Rule
rules.body: Green and gold communicate source or score state. They are not alternate brand accents.

rules.name: The Readout Rule
rules.body: Mono type identifies measurable or operational information. It does not replace readable body copy.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Data regions are separated by hairlines and tone. A shadow must explain interaction or layering.

dos: Do begin with the user's task and expose the ranking logic nearby.
Do pair every recommendation with source quality, freshness, and missing-data context.
Do use compact grids, shared rules, and deliberate whitespace to organize dense information.
Do keep mobile controls reachable and analytical overflow contained.
Do preserve keyboard focus, reduced-motion behavior, and non-color status labels.
donts: Don't present one universal leaderboard as objective truth.
Don't fill the page with interchangeable rounded cards.
Don't use copper, green, or gold as decoration.
Don't hide methodology behind an unexplained score.
Don't animate plots or controls when the motion does not clarify a state change.
